sharedPrompt: A professional game UI concept sheet for FIRE SLOP, a funny single-player low-poly 3D firefighter rescue game. Wide landscape canvas divided strictly into four equal landscape game screen mockups in an exact 2 by 2 grid, edge to edge, thin dark seams, no perspective, no outer board, no extra captions. Same art direction throughout: fire station shift log. Deep petrol blue, warm ivory, vermilion enamel primary buttons, mustard reflective accents, compact rounded corners, strong condensed dark sans titles, monospaced numeric readouts. Distinctive screenprinted illustration textures with sparse pencil hatching on scenery only. Chunky playful fireman with huge helmet and tiny dot eyes. Professional legible English in-game UI. Few words, meticulous visual hierarchy.

sheets.station: Upper left: loading screen, oversized FIRE SLOP title, illustrated firefighter tangled in a blue hose, a loading bar integrated into the hose and 68%. Upper right: dispatch home with warm fire station interior, fireman at left, prominent PLAY dispatch ticket at right followed by Wardrobe, Rewards, Ranking, coin balance. Lower left: Daily rewards calendar overlay with 7 consecutive cards DAY 1 through DAY 7, coin amounts 5, 8, 12, 18, 25, 35, 60 in that order, first claimed, second eligible, rest locked; coin wallet and close. Lower right: LOCAL RANKING leaderboard, avatars atop 2-1-3 podium, several tightly spaced ranked rows with numeric scores, pinned YOU row at bottom, wallet and close.
sheets.equipment: Upper left: WARDROBE on Outfit tab. Full body firefighter on a turntable left, silhouette category tabs for hat, uniform, gloves, boots, glasses, moustache above catalog right. Show several distinct clothing thumbnails, selected paid item, coin balance and coin icon 180 Buy. Upper right: same wardrobe in Eyewear tab, large close-up of same goofy fireman in goggles left, grid of different eyewear, owned checkmark and Save. Lower left: SETTINGS as a small ivory audio console centered over a dimly visible burning apartment scene; precisely two horizontal sliders labeled Music 60% and Effects 80%, close X. Lower right: victory screen as a perforated incident report on desk, ink stamp ALL RESCUED, three resident silhouettes with checkmarks, prominent '3/3 residents rescued', large time 03:42.18, Restart primary and Menu secondary buttons.
sheets.mission: Four first/third person GAMEPLAY screens showing airy minimalist overlays over actual stylized 3D-looking illustrated worlds with open center. Upper left DESKTOP ground first-person courtyard facing a three-storey brick apartment with one window on fire, gloved hands hold hose, tiny central crosshair, rescue objective 1/3 upper left, timer and gear upper right, three slots Hose, Hammer, Smoke along bottom, small contextual E Open door near target. Upper right TOUCH ground first-person inside a burning apartment looking at resident near wardrobe, movement joystick bottom left, large use action, jump and crouch buttons lower right, tool slots along bottom middle, context 'Pick up', rescue counter and timer. Lower left TOUCH drone piloting in third-person behind open-deck quadcopter carrying firefighter, above roofs, thumbstick left, altitude up/down buttons right, crosshair, timer and rescue count. Lower right DESKTOP cat encounter, oversized comic ginger cat clinging to camera, visible paws, urgent 'Shake off' action prompt, yellow partially filled struggle meter, retain timer and rescue progress at edges. No false health, ammo or energy bars.
sheets.context: Four first-person mission HUD states. Upper left: carrying a goofy resident in your gloved arms in the foreground, aiming toward a marked rescue tent, inactive tool slots, release/throw context, rescue counter 2/3. Upper right: from an apartment roof aiming a smoke canister; vivid green curved throw trajectory terminating at a translucent GREEN full-size 4-rotor drone landing ghost on a clear flat rooftop, no crosshair. Bottom left: throwing a red brick at a second-floor window, big gloved hand holding brick and visible curved trajectory to glass. Bottom right: proposed QUEST TRACKER integrated as a compact three-line checklist at the top over apartment gameplay, separate rescue objective and timer. Rows are 'Knock down doors 2/5', 'Break windows 4/10', 'Calm cats 1/2', with small coin reward symbols. Restrict overlays to edges. No captions around screens, no health or ammunition bars.
